We got many templates. Need one that corresponds to carbonyl-ene reaction. Look at template 1209837: retro_smarts_template '[C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(=C)-C(=O)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2](-[C:3])-[C:4]'. This seems to be reverse of carbonyl-ene? Forward: C-C(=C)-C(=O)-O... -> product with OH. That matches carbonyl-ene forward (ketone + alkene -> alcohol). So retro template (our direction) is product -> reactants: product has C-C(-OH) etc. So we can use this template.

We need to apply this template to target molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template with template_id maybe reaction_id? The tool expects template_id string. We need template ID. The search result gave reaction_id 1209837. Likely template ID is that number as string. Let's try apply_template with that ID.
